entitlement_rules.allocation_scope: A single license allocation can be assigned to only one VCF Operations instance.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: The VCF edition and the single unsplittable allocation are reconciled to exactly one VCF Operations instance.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Entitlement inventory identifies allocation vcf-prod-768 and a one-instance maximum.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: Aria Suite Lifecycle reports version 8.18.0 Patch 2 before any VCF 9 migration workflow starts.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Installed-patch inventory reports Patch 2 and product inventory synchronization succeeds.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: Application-consistent backups and supported snapshots exist for all three source products and restore checks pass.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Restore test records cover ops-prod, auto-prod, and logs-prod at their inventoried versions.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: Fleet prechecks pass for the supported 8.18.3 to 9.0.2 in-place upgrade and the four-node target placement has reserved capacity.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Successful upgrade precheck and DFW reservation records are attached to the change.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: The single VCF Operations instance is registered to allocation vcf-prod-768 and the management vCenter is licensed and managed.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: VCF Operations shows an active allocation and vc-m01.northstar.example as a managed licensed vCenter.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: The existing Automation 8.18.1 deployment is imported from legacy Lifecycle as an integrated Fleet Management instance.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Fleet inventory reports auto-prod with the expected three nodes and healthy services.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: Automation upgrade prechecks pass and identity ownership plus embedded Orchestrator dependencies are validated before cutover.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: The 9.0.2 deployment reports healthy services and sampled deployments, templates, subscriptions, and workflows pass validation.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: A new four-node VCF Operations for Logs 9.0.2 cluster is healthy at the reserved DFW placement while the source remains online.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: All four target nodes are healthy and the source 8.18.1 cluster is still available for parallel operation.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: All inventoried integrations and supported content are recreated and a licensed vCenter 9 source is collecting.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Fourteen integrations collect successfully, content counts reconcile, and the Logs license state is active.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: The supported last 90 days of retained logs are transferred and older data is explicitly excluded from the target.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Oldest searchable target event is within the 90-day transfer boundary and sample searches reconcile.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: Target health, sizing headroom, content counts, collection, automation execution, and log search tests all pass.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: The validation record reconciles every carried, recreated, and abandoned content class in the plan.

ordered_steps.gate_criterion: The rollback observation period is complete and the preserved source backups and older-log archive are readable before shutdown.
ordered_steps.gate_evidence: Backup restore metadata and the older-than-90-day log archive both pass readability checks.
